eat-drink.title: Give Madrid's churros time in the chocolate
eat-drink.eaValue: Something familiar becomes more revealing when you pay attention to how its two parts are eaten together.

eat-drink.title: Taste Montréal's smoked meat at the deli table
eat-drink.eaValue: A sandwich becomes a way to recognise a city's particular food vocabulary, not just a large portion of meat.

eat-drink.title: Open the egg around Bangkok's pad thai
eat-drink.eaValue: Recognition can be the beginning of curiosity when you ask what makes this version different.

make-learn.title: Lift a sheet of paper from water in Tokyo
make-learn.eaValue: Paper stops looking like an empty background and becomes something deliberately made.

make-learn.title: Repeat a copper stamp across batik in Ubud
make-learn.eaValue: A repeated pattern can begin to look more human once you have tried to align it yourself.

make-learn.title: Weave a small line through Bukchon's craft day
make-learn.eaValue: A neighbourhood becomes more than a backdrop when you spend part of the visit learning a material process there.

move-water.title: Let the Manly ferry open Sydney Harbour
move-water.eaValue: The space between destinations becomes part of the destination itself.

move-water.title: Climb into Santa Teresa on Rio's yellow bonde
move-water.eaValue: A climb can explain the relationship between a neighbourhood and the city below it.

move-water.title: Read Hong Kong Island from a ding ding
move-water.eaValue: Moving more slowly can reveal connections that a fast underground journey hides.

explore-reflect.title: Learn to look at rock art in Johannesburg
explore-reflect.eaValue: Looking becomes more interesting when you separate your first guess from an explanation supported by evidence.

explore-reflect.title: Put human time beside Nairobi's museum tools
explore-reflect.eaValue: A small object can make the human timescale feel larger than the monuments normally used to measure a trip.

explore-reflect.title: Meet Chile before the map in Santiago
explore-reflect.eaValue: A country can become a layered geography of peoples and practices rather than a single cultural label.

swim-reset.title: Take one slow circuit of Vancouver's Nitobe Garden
swim-reset.eaValue: A change in viewpoint can make a small place feel spacious without adding another activity.

swim-reset.title: Find a slower Lima between the olive trees
swim-reset.eaValue: A city can offer relief through a familiar public space rather than a separate escape from it.

swim-reset.title: Read a few pages inside Beitou's wooden library
swim-reset.eaValue: An admired building can become a useful part of your day without needing a purchase or a guided tour.

shared-rituals.title: Become one note in Bandung's angklung audience
shared-rituals.eaValue: Participation becomes cooperation when your small part only makes sense alongside other people's parts.

shared-rituals.title: Listen around Nashville's bluegrass picking circle
shared-rituals.eaValue: A music city becomes more legible when you hear how players listen to one another, not only how they perform for an audience.

shared-rituals.title: Hear Buenos Aires from a seat in the Colón
shared-rituals.eaValue: An architectural landmark becomes a place where people are doing something together now.
